- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:entire file | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The live hook copy was not updated with the template fixes, leaving the interactive hook stale and out of parity.
  WHY: The live copy still has the old behavior, causing deterministic CI test failures and a failed byte-equality parity check.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 136-139 (_SHELL_HEREDOC_READERS) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The live hook still treats wrapper commands as shell heredoc readers, so data heredocs run through wrappers such as `env` are parsed as shell.
  WHY: The unbalanced-quote heredoc test prompts for confirmation instead of allowing the data heredoc.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 298 (_shell_segments_with_redirects regex) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The redirect/operator regex does not recognize `|&` as a single operator and splits it into `|` and `&`.
  WHY: The guard loses the push directory and asks for confirmation for `true |& cd /tmp; git push origin feature/open`.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 583 (_guarded_git_invocations, in_pipeline) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Pipeline detection does not include `|&`.
  WHY: A `cd` inside a `|&` pipeline is not skipped and `conditional_cd` is not preserved, leaving pipeline-aware directory tracking incomplete.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 589 (conditional_cd operator set) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The conditional `cd` operator set does not include `|&`.
  WHY: When `operator == "|&"` and `conditional_cd` is set from a prior `cd`, the working directory is incorrectly nullified.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 445-449 and 464-466 (_strip_data_heredoc_bodies); .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:445-469 (`_strip_data_heredoc_bodies`) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Heredoc stripping lacks suffix detection, delimiter-completeness handling, and a backslash-continuation guard, so it can strip commands after heredocs, including executed pushes.
  WHY: A partial delimiter match such as `EOF` for `EOF-TEXT` can cause the trailing push to be omitted from the merged-PR check and return 0 instead of blocking.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 454, 464-466 (_strip_data_heredoc_bodies, runs_as_shell check) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `runs_as_shell` check omits the suffix scan, trailing-pipe check, delimiter fallback, and continuation fallback.
  WHY: Shell heredoc bodies that should be retained and parsed are stripped, including piped-reader and trailing-pipe cases.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 160-161, 429-434 (`_strip_data_heredoc_bodies` and `_HEREDOC_DELIMITER_END`) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The template parser fails to recognize heredoc delimiters containing hyphens, such as `<<EOF-1`.
  WHY: Hyphenated-delimiter heredocs can be left unchanged, causing false prompts or parsing errors if their bodies contain git commands.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2167 (parity test), agents.md "Live `.claude/` copies and their templates" contract, workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md mirror contract | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The live and template hooks are not byte-identical despite the documented parity contract.
  WHY: The parity test will fail, and consumer repos syncing the template will receive behavior that current interactive sessions do not have.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: line 136-139 (_SHELL_HEREDOC_READERS)
  severity=BLOCKER
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The live copy still lists wrapper commands `watch`, `timeout`, `nice`, `nohup`, `env`, `exec`, `command`, `stdbuf` as shell heredoc readers. These wrappers run the next word, so `env cat <<'EOF'` with `it's` in the body prompts for confirmation instead of being allowed.
  WHY: The CI test `test_data_heredoc_with_unbalanced_quotes_does_not_prompt[env cat <<'EOF'\nit's data\nEOF]` fails because the hook tries to parse `cat`'s data-heredoc body as shell through the `env` wrapper, hits the unbalanced quote, and asks for confirmation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: line 298 (_shell_segments_with_redirects regex)
  severity=BLOCKER
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The regex `r"&>>|&>|&&|\|\||>>|>\||>&|<&|<<<|<<|<>|[;<>&|\n]"` lacks `\|&`, so `|&` is split into `|` and `&`. The `&` part causes the guard to set `working_directory = None`, making the push directory unknown.
  WHY: CI test `test_pipe_or_unrelated_or_list_keeps_push_directory_known[true |& cd /tmp; git push origin feature/open]` fails because the guard cannot resolve the push directory and asks for confirmation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: line 583 (_guarded_git_invocations, in_pipeline)
  severity=BLOCKER
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `in_pipeline = operator == "|" or next_operator == "|"` does not include `"|&"`, so a `|&` pipeline is not recognized as a pipeline. A `cd` inside a `|&` pipeline is not skipped, and `conditional_cd` is not preserved across `|&`.
  WHY: Together with the regex issue above, pipeline-aware directory tracking is incomplete; commands separated by `|&` lose their directory context when they should keep it.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: line 589 (conditional_cd operator set)
  severity=BLOCKER
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `if operator not in ("", "&&", "|") and conditional_cd:` does not include `"|&"`, so when `operator == "|&"` and `conditional_cd` is set from a prior `cd`, the working directory is incorrectly nullified.
  WHY: A `cd /tmp |& some_command; git push` would lose the directory context when it should keep it, leading to unnecessary confirmation prompts.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: lines 445-449 and 464-466 (_strip_data_heredoc_bodies)
  severity=BLOCKER
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heredoc-stripping logic has three gaps relative to the template copy: (a) the 4-tuple `pending.append((...))` carries no suffix, so a shell reader after the operator on the same line (`cat <<EOF | bash`) is not detected; (b) no `_HEREDOC_DELIMITER_END` check exists, so `<<EOF-TEXT` is read as delimiter `EOF` and the real closing line plus subsequent commands are stripped as body text; (c) no `\\` line-continuation guard, so a continued heredoc line is partially stripped.
  WHY: CI test `test_heredoc_that_hides_an_executed_push_still_blocks[cat <<EOF-TEXT\npayload\nEOF-TEXT\ngit push origin feature/x]` fails — the push is stripped with the heredoc body and the hook returns 0 instead of blocking the push. Tests `test_heredoc_run_as_shell_is_still_parsed[cat <<'EOF' | bash]` and `test_heredoc_that_hides_an_executed_push_still_blocks` with piped-shell-reader cases also fail because the body is stripped when it should be kept and parsed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: lines 454, 464-466 (_strip_data_heredoc_bodies, runs_as_shell check)
  severity=BLOCKER
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `runs_as_shell` decision checks only `_SHELL_HEREDOC_READER_RE.search(prefix)`, missing: (a) `suffix` scan for a shell reader after the operator, (b) `suffix.rstrip().endswith("|")` for trailing pipe, (c) the `_HEREDOC_DELIMITER_END` fallback, (d) the `\\` continuation fallback.
  WHY: CI test `test_strip_data_heredoc_bodies_keeps_operator_and_shell_bodies` fails — the assertion `assert guard._strip_data_heredoc_bodies(partial_delimiter) == partial_delimiter` fails because the old code strips the body of `cat <<EOF-1\nx\nEOF-1\ngit push` to just `cat <<EOF-1`, losing the `git push` that follows. The piped-reader and trailing-pipe tests also fail because bodies that should be kept are stripped.
